title: Elixir of the Colossus
summary: Until Long Rest, increase your size, deal 1d4 extra weapon damage and gain advantage on Strength checks and saving throws.

fields.Drink: Bonus Action. Consume one bottle. Until Long Rest, increase your size and carrying capacity by 25%, deal 1d4 extra weapon damage, and gain advantage on Strength checks and saves.
fields.Stacking: Replaces other normal elixirs and can be overwritten by another.
fields.Crafting: Combine Salts of Chasm Creeper with any Suspension.
fields.Honour Mode: Removes Reduced and Enlarged. Giant Form removes this elixir’s condition. It stacks with Giant’s Rage.

changes: Added native BG3 gameplay details with pinned item and linked rules evidence. Verified card mechanics against the cited item or linked rule.
